reviews.title: Great until ads took over
reviews.text: I really loved using this app. I like how I could create playlists and I thought the app was easy to use. However, recently they started putting ads with timers on certain pages!  So now when I click on the Downloads tab, I get an ad that I have to wait 7 seconds for until I can cancel the ad and continue to the page. This is so disruptive that I’ve decided to go back to using Apple Podcasts app instead. What a bummer!!

reviews.text: This used to be a superb podcast player. Lately it’s been going down the drain. reviews.title: DO NOT GET THE UPDATE
reviews.text: I am heart broken. I have loved using Castbox for the past nearly 11 years now. I got the update because the app was glitching when I would try to share a podcast. Biggest regret. I lost EVERYTHING. All my history, my favorites, my curated playlists, my subscriptions, the last decade of my life on this app of media that shaped me and helped me be who I am today.

reviews.title: Contains scam ads
reviews.text: I went to search for a podcast and an ad popped up that replicated the general look of an iPhone screen. It told me memory was full (it is definitely not even close to being full) telling me I needed to purchase something. This ad is obviously a scam meant to fool people. I uninstalled Castbox immediately.

reviews.title: Long-Time User Disappointed by Recent Updates
reviews.text:
I’ve used CastBox for years and always loved it, especially the ability to download episodes and listen offline. But after the recent updates, downloaded episodes no longer play without an internet connection. This was never an issue before and  as someone who listens during commutes, travels, and times when internet is unavailable, this change has made the app unusable for me.

I hope the team fixes this, but until then I’m switching to another podcast app that still supports real offline listening.
